caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement on a textured, tan-colored background. At the top center, there is a stylized cross in gold with a red border and light blue accents inside, surrounded by faint yellow lines radiating outward. Directly below the cross is a bow-like shape, also gold with a red interior border and light blue outer edge, with concentric dotted details and a central round shape colored in blue with intersecting gold and red lines. On either side of the bow, there are gold, wing-like shapes with three red tips each. Beneath these elements is a large, circular medallion divided into repeating geometric patterns: the central core is blue, surrounded by a red and gold sunburst pattern, then a blue scallop-like border, with additional yellow and red repeating motifs around the outer edge. The entire composition is composed of shades of gold, red, and blue, with defined outlines, and is set against a uniformly textured tan background.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
